description: baseline (SDXS-512 CoreML CPU_AND_GPU on M3 Ultra 512GB)
use np.asarray to avoid redundant copies from CoreML predictions
pre-allocate rgb_buf and use in-place post-processing ops (slower: 3 passes over array)
eliminate latent arithmetic allocations using out= buffers and pre-computed constants
float16 post-processing with pre-allocated buffers (float16 clip/copy much slower on aarch64)
use INTER_NEAREST for resize (faster for diffusion model input)
in-place feedback blend into _lat_buf (5 numpy calls outweigh 3 alloc savings)
pre-build CoreML input dicts in init (avoid per-frame dict alloc + coremltools overhead)
CHW post-processing with pre-alloc buffer, return BGR view (skip cvtColor, avoid 3 float32 allocs)
